title: feat(studio): the object designer opens full-screen on its metadata address, tabs in #36513's order
body:
Fixes #36904
Refs #36513 (its section 一, the tab order, is delivered here; its section 二 was superseded by epic #36890)
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- Studio 里点开一个对象，设计器在右侧整屏打开，有自己的地址；左上角 × 回对象列表，右上角 ‹ › 看上一个、下一个，设计器左边那一列对象列表没有了。
- 这是 Studio 改版专题里的对象设计器一张，也按之前定的把对象页签排成：记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API。
- 出错时管理员会打不开或改不了对象（Studio 最常用的路径），旧链接也会落到对象列表；整张合并即可撤回。
- 这张超过 3000 行（大部分是删掉只测旧左侧列表的测试），需要您审核后合并。

## What changes

- **The object designer is full-screen on the object's address**, `/studio/PKG/metadata/object/NAME`, mounted by the "All metadata" area (`StudioMetadataArea` → `areaItemOpensObjectDesigner`). Its header is the shared full-screen item header (`ResourceDetailHeader`): × back to the object list with the list's filter and sort, ‹ › through the list, Esc. No switcher, no "open in app" (epic decision 7).
- **No left list, no in-page New.** `DataPillar` takes `objectName` and designs that one object: the object rail, its search and customization filter, the in-page 新建 dialog and the empty-package state are gone. Creating an object is the object list's 「新建」 (`MetadataListCreateDialog`, #36897), which already has the OWD choice, the app-menu join and the read-only base's `.custom` landing; checked before deleting this copy.
- **Tabs in #36513's order**, verbatim: 记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API (`objectDesignerTabs.ts`). Narrow columns fold Hooks and API into "Advanced" first (below 1200px), then the other three (below 1000px); each trigger's menu lists only what is folded at its width (`dataTabsFold.ts`). The five header icons became tabs through the shared `ItemToolTabs` (hand-off brief): References, History (audit log inside), Source (layers inside). The open tab is `?tab=` in the address, carried by ‹ ›.
- **The address switch.** `object` leaves `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR`, so every `studioItemPath` producer opens the new address: the app's 「对象设置」 (`appStudioObjectPath`), the record page's 「配置页面」 (`recordTabsStudioPath`), ⌘K, the AI artifact link, and the switched-off action link (`?action=NAME` on the new address). `/studio/PKG/data` redirects (`dataPillarRedirect`): with `?surface=object:NAME` to that object's designer (`?action=` kept; `?view=`, `?nav=` dropped), otherwise to the object list (`?changes=review`, the server's draft-review link, kept). A `.custom` pair's old address lands on the pair's own area. Live object requests from the Changes sheet navigate to the address.
- **`AreaHistoryRedirect`:** objects no longer take the designer-item exemption (`/metadata/object/NAME/history` opens the designer's History tab). The line itself stays for flows until #36903; removing it now would send a flow's history to the flow pillar and lose it.
- Kept as the card asks: the copilot's 「对象 · 页签」 chip and the AI-change line. The copilot read the open item only from `?surface=`, which the new address does not carry, so it now also reads it from a metadata address path (`metadataAddressArtifact`).
- Fixed on the way: a partly refused AI-drafts discard kept its message for one render only (the object re-read the discard triggers cleared `error`); it is now its own state. The retired-Interfaces notice is latched on the landing path, not the pillar, since the home is the area's object list now.

## Tests

- New: `objectDesignerTabs.test.ts` (order word for word, address round trip, tool tabs, values that open nothing); `metadataArea.test.ts` (`areaItemOpensObjectDesigner`, `dataPillarRedirect`, `metadataAddressArtifact`); `DataPillar.flatTabs-12450` rewritten for the ruled order, the two-step fold and `?tab=`.
- Rehosted on the list dialog (the create's home now): the OWD default, the stored-name preview and the taken-identifier refusal into `MetadataListCreateDialog.pairCreate-36897`; the app-menu join suite, the OWD select, the labels and the taken-identifier object block onto `MetadataListCreateDialog`.
- Converted: about 60 designer and surface suites now open the object on its address (`objectName`, area routes).
- Deleted, behaviour removed by this card, each with the pin that remains: `StudioDesignSurface.emptyPackage` (no in-page empty state), `StudioDesignSurface.createObjectOwd` (duplicated in `MetadataListCreateDialog.pairCreate-36897`: chosen and default `sharingModel`, `mode: 'draft'`), `DataPillar.railSwitchFlush-27511`, `DataPillar.surfaceRequest` (the pillar's own live-request apply; the surface's navigation is pinned in `heldDataCreate-26845`), `DataPillar.draftObjectLabel-11843` (the rail's label read; the header's label is pinned in `draftOnlyNoLayers-12508`), `StudioDesignSurface.aiApplyRefresh` (the rail growing on the pulse); and the rail-only cases inside `autosaveSwitch-11232`, `celGate`, `actionDeepLink-34724`, `heldDataLeave-26705` (the rail switch case became × back to the list), `StudioRail.noMatches-26733` (Data rail), `oneSurface-28572` (pair rows on the rail).

## Acceptance notes

- **For #36903:** `AreaHistoryRedirect`'s designer-item exemption line now serves flows only; #36903 deletes it when the flow designer moves.
- **Old base address of a pair's object:** `/studio/BASE/data?surface=object:PAIR_OBJECT` (what the retired rail mirrored for an object the `.custom` pair adds) now redirects to the base's area, where that name does not resolve; the pair's own address works, and the object list links pair rows to it.
- **Paused #36784** (public forms, now closed): it conflicted textually with this branch on `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, the Data pillar mount removed here.
- Sibling drafts #37089 (#36905, permission designer) and #37108 (#36900, ⌘K) conflict textually on `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` and the address files; whichever lands second merges main.
- Size: over 3,000 changed lines, Tier H by size (maintainer ruling recorded on epic #36890, comment 7145880574). Most of it is deleted tests of removed behaviour.

## Verification

Read first (risk order): `views/studio-design/DataPillar.tsx` (the removed rail and create, the header and tab block), `views/studio-design/StudioMetadataArea.tsx` + `metadataArea.ts` (the mount and `dataPillarRedirect`), `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (the `/data` redirect and `requestSurface`).

Two-minute check: on HotCRM, open an app's 「对象设置」. Expected: the URL is `/studio/PKG/metadata/object/NAME`, the designer fills the right pane with no object column, the tabs read 记录、字段布局、验证、操作、设置、钩子、API、被引用、历史、源码; › opens the next object on the same tab; × returns to the object list.
